attempts.summary: On node1, built a 2.15 GiB LVM logical volume (vgdata/lvdata) backed by two loop-mounted files (no spare block device existed on this VM), mounted it at /srv/data, grew it online from ~1000M to ~2.15G via vgextend+lvextend+xfs_growfs while it stayed mounted with data intact, made the setup boot-persistent (systemd loop-reattach unit + fstab dependency), and verified full recovery (changed boot_id, mount, LV size, checksums) across a real reboot of node1.
